question:
[真实 issue 改编:freegs-plasma/freegs #128] Equilibrium.triangularityLower() 当前返回的是上三角度(upper triangularity)而不是下三角度——它错误地复用了 triangularityUpper() 的逻辑。物理定义:下三角度 δ_lower = (R0 - R_P4)/a,其中 R_P4 是最后闭合磁面(LCFS)上 Z 坐标最小点(bottom point)的 R 坐标,R0 与 a 为 LCFS 的几何中心与小半径。

当前实现(freegs/equilibrium.py 中)用 np.argmax(Zlcfs) 取了最高点(topmost),正确实现应用 np.argmin(Zlcfs) 取最低点。

请给出修复该 bug 的 unified diff 补丁(直接修改 freegs 源码;只改 triangularityLower 的实现逻辑,不要改函数签名)。评分方式(SWE-bench 形式):补丁应用到 base 环境后运行 FAIL_TO_PASS 测试 tests/swe/test_freegs_triangularity_lower.py(该测试从 LCFS 数组独立重算期望值并断言,容差 1e-6)。

question_en:
[Adapted from real issue freegs-plasma/freegs #128] Equilibrium.triangularityLower() currently returns the UPPER triangularity instead of the LOWER one — it wrongly reuses the logic of triangularityUpper(). Physical definition: lower triangularity delta_lower = (R0 - R_P4)/a, where R_P4 is the R coordinate of the BOTTOM (minimum-Z) point of the last closed flux surface (LCFS), and R0, a are the LCFS geometric center and minor radius.

The current implementation (in freegs/equilibrium.py) uses np.argmax(Zlcfs) to pick the TOPMOST point; the correct implementation must use np.argmin(Zlcfs) to pick the bottom point.

Provide a unified-diff patch that fixes the bug (modify the freegs source directly; change only the triangularityLower implementation logic, do not change the function signature). Grading (SWE-bench style): your patch is applied onto the base environment, then the FAIL_TO_PASS test tests/swe/test_freegs_triangularity_lower.py is run (the test independently recomputes the expected value from the LCFS arrays and asserts it, tolerance 1e-9).
